meta_description: Ash Autotech is a mobile mechanic and electrician serving Birmingham. We come to you for fast, honest vehicle repairs and electrical diagnostics.
hero_eyebrow: Mobile Mechanic — We Come to You
hero_subhead: Ash Autotech brings professional diagnostics and repairs to your driveway. No garage delays, no excessive markups.
services_subhead: From routine maintenance to complex electrical faults, Ash Autotech diagnoses and fixes your car at home or work.

services.title: Engine Diagnostics & Repair
services.desc: Computer-aided fault-finding and repair for all makes. Most issues identified and resolved on the first visit, saving you time and money.

services.title: Vehicle Electrical Work
services.desc: Alternators, starter motors, battery issues, and wiring faults diagnosed and fixed with modern test equipment. Specialists in modern vehicle electrics.

services.title: Brake & Suspension Repairs
services.desc: Pads, discs, calipers, shock absorbers, and suspension geometry work. We carry common parts on the van for faster turnaround.

services.title: MOT Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: Pre-MOT checks and repairs to ensure your vehicle passes first time. Honest advice on what needs fixing and what can wait.

services.title: Routine Servicing & Maintenance
services.desc: Oil changes, filter replacements, fluid top-ups, and seasonal checks. Extends vehicle life and prevents costly breakdowns.

services.title: Air Conditioning & Cooling System Work
services.desc: AC regas, condenser repairs, radiator flushes, and coolant diagnostics. Keeps your car running cool and reliably.

about_pullquote: I started this because people were paying through the nose for simple jobs.
about_para_1: Ash Autotech was born from frustration — seeing friends and neighbours overcharged for straightforward vehicle repairs. With 12 years of hands-on experience under my belt, I decided to offer Birmingham a better alternative: honest, skilled mobile mechanics who come to you. No inflated garage forecourt prices, no pressure to fix things that don't need fixing.
about_para_2: We've built a strong reputation on transparency and reliability. Customers return because we explain what we find, quote fairly, and get the job done right first time. Whether you're in King's Heath, Edgbaston, or across Greater Birmingham, Ash Autotech brings workshop-standard diagnostics and repair skill directly to your driveway.

reviews.text: Ash came out on a Saturday morning when my car wouldn't start. Diagnosed a faulty alternator, had a replacement fitted in under two hours. Charged me a fair price and even explained what caused the fault. Best mechanic I've found in Birmingham.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: No more garage visits for me. Ash is brilliant — turns up on time, knows what he's doing, and doesn't try to sell you work you don't need. My Mrs won't go anywhere else now. Proper honest tradesman.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Called Ash about a warning light on the dashboard. He came round, plugged in his diagnostic kit, and found the issue in minutes. Fixed it for a fraction of what Halfords quoted me. Definitely recommend him to anyone with car trouble.
reviews.author: Sarah P.
